4f1b24125097e51ec7d741ae3ea1ed4dcc781bb7.source: 可以从灰度语谱图生成近似声音，也可以在频谱上绘画并试听变化。先按素材选择 <s id="0">图片重建</s>、<s id="1">图片涂鸦重建</s> 或 <s id="2">音频藏信息</s>。图片需要手动标定，音频直接使用文件自带的时间、频率和声道。
4f1b24125097e51ec7d741ae3ea1ed4dcc781bb7.translation: Generate approximate sound from a grayscale spectrogram, or draw on spectra and listen to changes. Choose <s id="0">Image reconstruction</s>, <s id="1">Drawn-image reconstruction</s>, or <s id="2">Hide information in audio</s> for your material. Images require manual calibration; audio uses its own timing, frequency, and channels.

14370791a8e58555486d26e14413fc0dfb10afc4.source: <s id="0">图片结果是根据灰度频谱得到的近似重建。</s> 音频藏信息用于在频谱中绘制信息，处理后请检查声音及压缩后的可读性。需要保密时请使用专门的加密工具。
14370791a8e58555486d26e14413fc0dfb10afc4.translation: <s id="0">Image results are approximate reconstructions from grayscale spectra.</s> Information hiding draws information in spectra; inspect sound and readability after compression. Use dedicated encryption tools for confidentiality.

e23138da9ff3d4d86e99e9b4455015b60e1a0f81.source: <s id="0">图片</s>：PNG、JPEG、BMP，≤16 MB。优先使用黑强白弱的灰度谱，时间向右、高频向上，频率轴为线性刻度。记录图中的时间、频率、灰度标度和分析窗长。
e23138da9ff3d4d86e99e9b4455015b60e1a0f81.translation: <s id="0">Images</s>: PNG, JPEG, BMP, ≤16 MB. Prefer grayscale with black stronger and white weaker, time rightward, high frequencies upward, and a linear frequency scale. Record time, frequency, grayscale range, and analysis window length.

92ac7f8ef1bde5f73f20388a3c346262bded56f0.source: <s id="0">彩色、反色或对数频率谱</s>：先依据原色标和坐标轴转换。普通去色无法可靠还原任意色标。选区尽量避开标题、轴文字、网格和箭头，它们也会进入重建。
92ac7f8ef1bde5f73f20388a3c346262bded56f0.translation: <s id="0">Color, inverted, or log-frequency spectra</s>: convert using the original color bar and axes first. Ordinary desaturation cannot reliably invert arbitrary color maps. Exclude titles, axis text, grids, and arrows from the selection because they also enter reconstruction.

b2f3254b46b14b5c212df75a10758c3270d8b3b2.source: <s id="0">音频</s>：WAV、MP3、FLAC，≤64 MB、≤30 秒、8–96 kHz、单/双声道。保留原文件，有损格式以解码后的声音为起点。
b2f3254b46b14b5c212df75a10758c3270d8b3b2.translation: <s id="0">Audio</s>: WAV, MP3, FLAC, ≤64 MB, ≤30 seconds, 8–96 kHz, mono/stereo. Retain originals; lossy inputs start from decoded sound.

f5e6ab43b36a2a1312f8e3e38894a32226dd8802.source: <s id="0">图片默认标定只是初始值。</s> 缺少原图条件时可试不同设置，但应记录假设，避免将结果当作原作者提供的录音。
f5e6ab43b36a2a1312f8e3e38894a32226dd8802.translation: <s id="0">Default image calibration is only a starting value.</s> Without original conditions, try settings but record assumptions; do not treat results as recordings supplied by the original author.

a4b80aaa078e12fc8f8e8851e296601eb6ce9b6d.source: 按图源填写时间左右边界、频率上下边界、<s id="0">最小 dB（白）</s>、<s id="1">最大 dB（黑）</s> 和 <s id="2">窗长（ms）</s>。终点须大于起点，时长≤30秒，最高频率≤48000 Hz。

054b68e822bd7aeee814c3d75b48cdd3d31614ba.source: 重建后先比较两张谱里的条纹、空白和起止，再试听。此例实际输出约 1.474 秒，填写范围为 1.5 秒，保存前以结果显示的实际时长为准。图片缺少原始相位，重建音频通过迭代估计相位。
054b68e822bd7aeee814c3d75b48cdd3d31614ba.translation: Compare stripes, blanks, and boundaries in both spectra, then listen. Actual output here is about 1.474 seconds versus entered 1.5 seconds; use displayed actual duration before saving. Images lack original phase, so reconstruction estimates it iteratively.

c7a548da3cdf507e96208b5c428bfe159521533d.translation: <s id="0">Phrase-spectrogram source: Julius O. Smith's Spectrograms textbook page.</s>

669af6ec5e306f0fb623ee9069158b59798f1f1a.source: 参数预测与 Mel 谱修复

d469a59c5cae4f8c396a4fd4de19a4b6eaa942d2.source: 先选择图片，填写时长、频率起止点和线性/对数轴，再点击“预测窗长与 dB 范围”。模型只预测窗长与动态范围，频率轴仍需手动选择。预测只填入一次，窗长与dB始终可编辑，重建保留当前值。两种算法均可使用内置预测。窗长取整数毫秒，帧移为四分之一窗长；Aoki短时窗初始化单独选择自动、开启脉冲或关闭使用随机相位，自动模式以15ms为界。新任务使用动量加速 Griffin–Lim，动量系数为0.99，默认32次迭代，上限256次。动量利用相邻两次迭代的变化推进相位估计，通常能更快收敛，实际听感仍需试听比较。它与Aoki相位初始化分别控制迭代过程和起始相位。当前界面不提供动量系数调节。历史legacy任务重试保留原有无动量语义。默认输出采样率为频率终点×2，重建频谱只显示所填频带，时间范围和像素长宽与输入一致。Mel 谱 → NAFNet → BigVGAN 先通过GL生成波形，再提取80带Mel谱、修复和声码器合成。参数预测模型已内置。修复与声码器需下载模型组件，安装后可离线使用。CPU组件直接下载，推理可能较慢；GPU可选择已有Python环境中的python.exe，点击检查兼容性，通过后选择GPU推理。不会自动安装或修改所选环境。参数预测与GL仍在CPU上运行，GPU用于修复与声码器。当前完整修复组件尚未公开提供服务器下载。最终整体增益将峰值限制在0.95以内。
d469a59c5cae4f8c396a4fd4de19a4b6eaa942d2.translation: Select an image, enter duration, frequency bounds, and linear/log axis, then click Predict window length and dB range. The model predicts only window length and dynamic range; choose the frequency axis manually. Prediction fills values once; window length/dB remain editable and reconstruction uses current values. Both algorithms support built-in prediction. Window length is integer milliseconds; hop is one quarter of it. Aoki short-window initialization separately offers Auto, On for pulses, or Off for random phase; Auto uses a 15 ms boundary. New tasks use momentum-accelerated Griffin–Lim, momentum 0.99, default 32 iterations, maximum 256. Momentum uses changes between adjacent iterations to advance phase estimation and usually converges faster; compare actual sound by listening. It controls iteration separately from Aoki's initial phase. The interface has no momentum adjustment. Retrying historical legacy tasks retains their nonmomentum semantics. Default output rate is final frequency ×2; reconstructed spectra show only the entered band, with time range and pixel dimensions matching input. Mel spectrum → NAFNet → BigVGAN first generates a waveform via GL, then extracts an 80-band Mel spectrum, restores it, and synthesizes with a vocoder. Parameter prediction is built in. Restoration/vocoder components require model downloads, then work offline. CPU components download directly but inference may be slow; for GPU, select python.exe in an existing Python environment, Check compatibility, then choose GPU inference after passing. The selected environment is not automatically installed or modified. Prediction and GL remain on CPU; GPU handles restoration/vocoder. Complete restoration components are not currently publicly downloadable from the server. Final global gain limits peaks to 0.95.

24e556a10770da5f606ac659b6793b8f4c031bcb.source: 桌面版的图片重建与图片涂鸦重建可以选择 BigVGAN 再合成。先在左栏点击下载 BigVGAN，完成校验和试运行后主动选择模型，再开始新任务。下载约 296.4 MB，安装后约占 848.2 MB。首次下载需要联网，之后可离线运行。CPU推理可能较慢，也可选择已有GPU Python环境并检查兼容性。默认仍使用现有重建方法。
24e556a10770da5f606ac659b6793b8f4c031bcb.translation: Desktop image and image-drawing reconstruction can use BigVGAN resynthesis. Download BigVGAN on the left; after validation and a test run, explicitly choose it before a new task. Download is about 296.4 MB, installed size about 848.2 MB. First download needs internet; later runs can be offline. CPU inference may be slow; an existing GPU Python environment can be selected and checked. The default remains the existing reconstruction method.

c12bc1a9bd5c13d2918bbc00048f237722fdcfbb.source: BigVGAN 从现有重建音频提取 Mel 频谱再合成，音色与噪声变化依材料而异。用相同图片与参数分别生成两种结果，再试听选择。输出采样率与样本数保持，来源 JSON 记录模型版本及增益。音频藏信息保留原始相位，不启用声码器。
c12bc1a9bd5c13d2918bbc00048f237722fdcfbb.translation: BigVGAN extracts a Mel spectrum from reconstructed audio and resynthesizes; timbre/noise changes depend on material. Generate both with identical images/settings and choose by listening. Sample rate and count remain; provenance JSON records model version and gain. Audio information hiding retains original phase and does not use a vocoder.

ce7e3a1ec281902da88b077fc067eb02134d369d.translation: Whitney Chappell's Observo spectrogram: time 0–0.7278 seconds, frequency 0–5000 Hz.

7f73a61397cae60a3cf1ab24effc1a15a7c165bc.translation: Actual reconstruction of Whitney Chappell's Observo spectrogram: corrected input left, reanalyzed actual output right.

e0661dbe93d7bd8552c3aa155f150486f7883eed.translation: Desktop screen capture and corner confirmation

e3035f5a594dbef2bfdca955a3f30aa482c98cc6.source: 在同一屏幕显示完整语谱主体，再回到图片模式点击 <s id="0">截取屏幕</s>。工具箱暂时隐藏，进入四角选择界面。
e3035f5a594dbef2bfdca955a3f30aa482c98cc6.translation: Display the whole spectral region on the same screen, return to image mode, and click <s id="0">Capture screen</s>. The toolbox hides temporarily and opens corner selection.

dc74f8aeebb3ef43ea5acdc7a3c2d9d0f9dd102a.source: 按左上、右上、右下、左下点击，连线应围成有效区域。选错用 Backspace、Delete 或右键撤销一点，按 R 重选。
dc74f8aeebb3ef43ea5acdc7a3c2d9d0f9dd102a.translation: Click top left, top right, bottom right, bottom left, forming a valid region. Backspace, Delete, or right-click undoes one point; R restarts.

bed2afb672b6d2d625ab5c7bf5a24a17116a9c15.source: <s id="0">选四点后还需按 Enter 确认。</s> Esc 取消并返回。截图和角点载入后，继续填写标定；截图不会自动识别时间、频率、dB 或窗长。
bed2afb672b6d2d625ab5c7bf5a24a17116a9c15.translation: <s id="0">Press Enter after choosing four points to confirm.</s> Esc cancels and returns. Once the screenshot/corners load, enter calibration; capture does not detect time, frequency, dB, or window length automatically.

4aea49190d025054aa0b0cf42131b7dd697be85f.source: 载入透视校正后的画布

e0a2dff06e4b2271543c96c79035c099e2ad8642.source: 选择 <s id="0">图片涂鸦重建</s>，选图并完成标定。展开 <s id="1">原图与四点校正</s>，使用整图或选四角。
e0a2dff06e4b2271543c96c79035c099e2ad8642.translation: Choose <s id="0">Drawn-image reconstruction</s>, select and calibrate an image. Expand <s id="1">Original image and four-point correction</s>, using the whole image or four corners.

d60753ee8873bd3e645cb23b2472dd5f50eb4470.source: 点击 <s id="0">应用校正并绘图</s>。看到拉正的底图后开始画，时间向右、高频向上。<s id="1">载入画布还没有生成音频。</s>
d60753ee8873bd3e645cb23b2472dd5f50eb4470.translation: Click <s id="0">Apply correction and draw</s>. Draw after the rectified image appears, with time rightward and high frequency upward. <s id="1">Loading the canvas has not generated audio.</s>

50b90282bac14fb57f4aca0155deb0b6a77eb205.source: 选 <s id="0">黑色画笔</s> 增强、<s id="1">白色画笔</s> 减弱，再调粗细和不透明度，用左键绘制。处理注释线时先小范围试画，避免覆盖真正的谱线。
50b90282bac14fb57f4aca0155deb0b6a77eb205.translation: Choose <s id="0">Black brush</s> to strengthen or <s id="1">White brush</s> to weaken; set size and opacity and left-drag. Try small areas first when removing annotations to avoid obscuring genuine spectral lines.

7315e093dae2d60619406fbd1bd0d0029dc07a48.source: 用 ＋ 或 Ctrl + 滚轮放大，选 <s id="0">拖动画面</s> 或按 Shift 拖动查看细节，用 <s id="1">撤销</s>、<s id="2">重做</s> 比较修改。
7315e093dae2d60619406fbd1bd0d0029dc07a48.translation: Zoom with + or Ctrl + wheel; choose <s id="0">Pan canvas</s> or Shift-drag for details. Compare edits with <s id="1">Undo</s> and <s id="2">Redo</s>.

b57b47e2245fd18b0b3ac279d66e6ab91d8990d8.source: 点击 <s id="0">生成涂鸦音频</s>。完成后对照包含笔迹的目标图和实际输出谱，试听并保存。
b57b47e2245fd18b0b3ac279d66e6ab91d8990d8.translation: Click <s id="0">Generate drawn audio</s>. Compare the target containing strokes with the actual-output spectrum, then listen and save.

8d92c94a3d4553f9f6ffbd93e41286acd049224a.source: 换图片或角点后须重新载入，<s id="0">重载会清空该画布的旧笔迹</s>。只改标定时可沿用笔迹重新生成，笔迹对应的时间、频率或幅值也会改变。
8d92c94a3d4553f9f6ffbd93e41286acd049224a.translation: Reload after changing image/corners; <s id="0">reloading clears old strokes for that canvas</s>. Calibration-only changes can reuse strokes for new generation, but their corresponding timing, frequency, or magnitude changes.

23cfda4b8dbfb8bbaf74bead27d03965a3db048a.source: <s id="0">白色画笔用于减弱频谱。</s> 要恢复上一笔请用 <s id="1">撤销</s>。图片涂鸦和图片重建都需估计相位。
23cfda4b8dbfb8bbaf74bead27d03965a3db048a.translation: <s id="0">White brush weakens the spectrum.</s> Use <s id="1">Undo</s> to restore the last stroke. Both image modes estimate phase.

c21b27b51d050c7c8ecdea291dce91e4dec87051.source: 绘图另用一张由自然单音节制作的灰度谱，时间 0–0.67212 秒、频率 0–8000 Hz、白 −60 dB、黑 0 dB、窗长 16 ms、32 次迭代、16000 Hz 输出。画两笔：黑色折线粗细 4、不透明度 60%，白色横线粗细 10、不透明度 50%。撤销白线后计数由 2 笔变为 1 笔，重做恢复 2 笔。
c21b27b51d050c7c8ecdea291dce91e4dec87051.translation: Drawing uses another grayscale image from a natural monosyllable: 0–0.67212 seconds, 0–8000 Hz, white −60 dB, black 0 dB, window 16 ms, 32 iterations, output 16000 Hz. Draw two strokes: black polyline size 4, opacity 60%; white horizontal line size 10, opacity 50%. Undo white changes count from 2 to 1; Redo restores 2.

5d7e2b44a3971a6106403f99793292a1b021f0fd.source: 图片涂鸦在透视校正后的网格画出黑色增强线和白色减弱线；画笔粗细、不透明度、缩放与两笔状态可见，尚未生成本次音频。
5d7e2b44a3971a6106403f99793292a1b021f0fd.translation: Black strengthening and white weakening lines drawn on the corrected image grid; size, opacity, zoom, and two-stroke state visible, before audio generation.

1308f983381d4747955d265403481049a4fed398.source: 撤销最后一笔后，画布只保留黑色增强线，计数回到一笔；重做按钮可用，可恢复白色减弱笔迹。
1308f983381d4747955d265403481049a4fed398.translation: Undo leaves only the black line and one stroke; Redo is available to restore white.

620703d7f1307aca6b8484dc7dfc25773ce695b6.source: 重做恢复白线后生成，先看新增谱带和减弱区域，再与同一底图未绘画的结果试听比较。
620703d7f1307aca6b8484dc7dfc25773ce695b6.translation: Redo white, then generate; compare added bands and weakened regions, then listen against the undrawn image result.

9ecbc1cd024b938f357536e1c3bc5704ea2eb07c.source: 图片涂鸦的两笔已进入正式任务，校正后的输入含笔迹，右图为实际 Griffin–Lim 输出重新分析的频谱。
9ecbc1cd024b938f357536e1c3bc5704ea2eb07c.translation: Two strokes submitted in an image-drawing task; corrected input contains strokes and the right reanalyzes actual Griffin–Lim output.

08370a311f5bd54091b8a13d82a98c6fcd5c0345.source: 绘图例子的自然单音节原声。可与下面同一底图的图片重建、图片涂鸦和音频藏信息结果对照。
08370a311f5bd54091b8a13d82a98c6fcd5c0345.translation: Natural monosyllable original for the drawing example. Compare with image reconstruction, image drawing, and audio-hiding results from the same base below.

de237862b36eadef6035dd257827110534de2be1.source: 绘图底图未加笔迹时的图片重建。与下一段加黑白两笔后的结果对照。
de237862b36eadef6035dd257827110534de2be1.translation: Image reconstruction without strokes on the drawing base. Compare with the next result using black/white strokes.

aca6a574b742469dc8d2e255206bd5c8a344aedd.source: 图片涂鸦结果：同一底图与标定加入黑色增强、白色减弱两笔，再经 32 次 Griffin–Lim 生成，16000 Hz PCM16、0.6680625 秒。与无笔迹图片结果比较新增频带和减弱区域。
aca6a574b742469dc8d2e255206bd5c8a344aedd.translation: Image-drawing result: same base and calibration with black/white strokes, 32 Griffin–Lim iterations, 16000 Hz PCM16, 0.6680625 seconds. Compare added bands and weakened areas with the undrawn reconstruction.

d12c75adef8e9db77a90f511a43103ab60087984.source: 载入源音频与选择编辑声道

ef5b979964d56f4d9e36ef41f801f5fcd2652670.source: 选择 <s id="0">音频藏信息</s>，点击 <s id="1">打开音频目录</s>，从 <s id="2">选择音频</s> 下拉选文件。目录只有一个音频时自动载入；有导入入口时先导入。核对时长、采样率、声道数。
ef5b979964d56f4d9e36ef41f801f5fcd2652670.translation: Choose <s id="0">Hide information in audio</s>, <s id="1">Open audio directory</s>, then a file under <s id="2">Select audio</s>. A sole audio file loads automatically; import first where available. Check duration, sample rate, and channels.

f999f13f160b2dea2ee734f857cda63c9de01ef1.source: 双声道默认编辑左声道，可选择右声道。<s id="0">频谱精度</s> 默认 1024，可选 512、2048。改声道或精度后点击 <s id="1">载入频谱</s>，旧笔迹会清空。
f999f13f160b2dea2ee734f857cda63c9de01ef1.translation: Stereo defaults to editing left; right is selectable. <s id="0">Spectral resolution</s> defaults to 1024, with 512 and 2048 available. After changing channel/resolution, <s id="1">Load spectrum</s> clears old strokes.

a477292b6386a01df8f140ec642b9d9c83f504ba.source: 音频藏信息模式载入单声道源音频后的频谱画布；图中尚无笔迹或生成结果。
a477292b6386a01df8f140ec642b9d9c83f504ba.translation: Audio-hiding canvas after loading a mono source, before strokes or generated results.

0edb0322215e205d5b31b2181102b7ca592630ff.source: 最大化的语谱图转音频工作台：音频藏信息模式显示频谱精度 1024、60 dB 显示范围、黑白画笔与零笔的源频谱画布。
0edb0322215e205d5b31b2181102b7ca592630ff.translation: Maximized workbench in audio-hiding mode with resolution 1024, display 60 dB, black/white brushes, and a source canvas with zero strokes.

4df9780c9695756f7b656c96b1d95ea87ce39301.source: 绘制、直接逆变换与核查

6cd9dca0d0094c1db367bd834f7e2ba10447a8ea.source: 在原声频谱上用黑白画笔绘制。需要细字或形状时放大并平移，调低不透明度可减轻修改。先画少量，再生成试听。
6cd9dca0d0094c1db367bd834f7e2ba10447a8ea.translation: Draw with black/white brushes on the source spectrum. Zoom/pan for fine text or shapes; lower opacity softens modifications. Begin with a few strokes, then generate and listen.

ba63540c223d4b4dd9d5dfe7cebca4a9a5cc646d.source: 点击 <s id="0">生成藏信息音频</s>。完成后比较 <s id="1">绘制后的目标频谱</s> 与 <s id="2">重建音频的频谱</s>，核对时长、采样率、声道和输出增益。
ba63540c223d4b4dd9d5dfe7cebca4a9a5cc646d.translation: Click <s id="0">Generate information-hiding audio</s>. Compare <s id="1">Drawn target spectrum</s> and <s id="2">Reconstructed audio spectrum</s>; check duration, sample rate, channels, and output gain.

8c589b3115620507dbec77421e11b7926b1b9007.source: 试听并保存四件套。继续改画后需再次生成；选历史条目只查看当时结果，不会将新笔迹写回旧任务。
8c589b3115620507dbec77421e11b7926b1b9007.translation: Listen and save all four files. Regenerate after further edits. History selection views that result only; new strokes do not alter old tasks.

472cdfd25476a664b877b1bb3bd063de41a923f5.source: 音频模式保留原频谱相位并直接逆变换，保持原采样率、样本数和声道数。只有选定声道参与编辑，原幅值为零的位置采用零相位。
472cdfd25476a664b877b1bb3bd063de41a923f5.translation: Audio mode retains original spectral phase and inverts directly, keeping original sample rate, sample count, and channels. Only the selected channel is edited; zero original magnitudes use zero phase.

5eeccb6a04a4c21763e96618a9dd08843e969f3a.source: 有效绘制使编辑声道超出满幅时，程序将该声道峰值缩到 0.99，并记录 <s id="0">输出增益</s>。这会影响整个编辑声道的声音，另一声道不参与此增益调整。
5eeccb6a04a4c21763e96618a9dd08843e969f3a.translation: If effective drawing takes the edited channel beyond full scale, its peak is reduced to 0.99 and <s id="0">Output gain</s> recorded. This affects the whole edited channel; the other channel receives no such gain.

ac1147c2303ec19f1d4014b404fe6167f5dc8d68.source: <s id="0">页内试听默认取左声道。</s> <s id="1">显示两个声道</s> 只改变波形显示。编辑右声道后，请保存 WAV，在支持声道选择的播放器或分析工具中选右声道复核。
ac1147c2303ec19f1d4014b404fe6167f5dc8d68.translation: <s id="0">In-page listening defaults to the left channel.</s> <s id="1">Show two channels</s> changes waveform display only. After right-channel editing, save WAV and check right in a channel-selectable player or analysis tool.

479592af611d8fafd94901f932fafb72fe2c980e.source: 本例直接编辑同一原声，频谱精度 1024，显示范围 60 dB，使用相同粗细和不透明度的黑白两笔。输出保持原时长，增益为 1.000。先与原声比较，再听图片涂鸦结果。两种画布网格不同，这组例音用于演示流程。
479592af611d8fafd94901f932fafb72fe2c980e.translation: This directly edits the same original at resolution 1024, display 60 dB, with identically sized/opaque black-white strokes. Duration is retained, gain 1.000. Compare to original, then image drawing. Canvas grids differ; these sounds demonstrate workflow.

05588c3795c6d837e97086ccc165792682013614.source: 单音节原声频谱在 1024 点 FFT、60 dB 显示范围下绘入黑白两笔；音频模式隐藏图片标定，并采用原始相位直接逆变换。
05588c3795c6d837e97086ccc165792682013614.translation: Black/white strokes drawn on the monosyllable's 1024-point FFT spectrum at 60 dB display. Audio mode hides image calibration and inverts directly with original phase.

0e81369d6a3012787f97d5c8964912b0f539e1da.source: 画笔粗细和不透明度分别调整，先用小笔画试听效果。
0e81369d6a3012787f97d5c8964912b0f539e1da.translation: Set brush size and opacity separately; start with small strokes and listen.

31aa16483384d9523319624ff3e58d18f5e96765.source: 音频藏信息任务完成，左图是绘制目标，右图是实际输出重新分析；两图同标度，结果保留 16000 Hz、原样本数与单声道。
31aa16483384d9523319624ff3e58d18f5e96765.translation: Completed audio-hiding task: target left, reanalyzed actual output right at the same scale. Retains 16000 Hz, original sample count, and mono.

213875fc227ab5f3dcffafe5f5bed72d6ee2057a.source: 音频藏信息结果：直接编辑源音的 1024 点 STFT 幅值，保留原始相位直接逆变换，不运行 Griffin–Lim。输出为 16000 Hz 单声道 FLOAT、0.672125 秒，增益 1.000。
213875fc227ab5f3dcffafe5f5bed72d6ee2057a.translation: Audio-hiding result: directly edits source 1024-point STFT magnitudes and inverts with original phase, without Griffin–Lim. Output 16000 Hz mono FLOAT, 0.672125 seconds, gain 1.000.

7d7d8ae0efe6fc8381b522f84fee95d11a24058f.source: 缩放、撤销与未提交笔迹保护
7d7d8ae0efe6fc8381b522f84fee95d11a24058f.translation: Zoom, undo, and protect unsubmitted strokes

18b18007016256065b53e4ac7ddf3bb8a3e1e171.source: <s id="0">显示缩放</s>：100–800%，Ctrl + 滚轮或 − / ＋ 调整，<s id="1">适合窗口</s> 回到 100%。放大不增加原谱细节。画笔直径按原图像素计算，可输入1–200 px，缩放不会改变实际笔宽。
18b18007016256065b53e4ac7ddf3bb8a3e1e171.translation: <s id="0">Display zoom</s>: 100–800%, with Ctrl + wheel or − / +; <s id="1">Fit window</s> restores 100%. Zoom adds no spectral detail. Brush diameter uses original-image pixels, 1–200 px; zoom does not change actual width.

1ce3d63ea856b7d3914cc56f0c71f17edbd4078c.source: <s id="0">逐笔撤销</s>：Ctrl + Z；<s id="1">重做</s>：Ctrl + Shift + Z，需焦点位于画布。撤销后新增一笔会清空重做记录。多笔重复覆盖会叠加，不透明度 0% 无幅值效果。
1ce3d63ea856b7d3914cc56f0c71f17edbd4078c.translation: <s id="0">Undo one stroke</s>: Ctrl + Z; <s id="1">Redo</s>: Ctrl + Shift + Z, with canvas focus. A new stroke after undo clears redo. Repeated overlaps accumulate; opacity 0% has no magnitude effect.

131ca80ce40f134eca467bd880e447efd1a52cee.source: 最多 256 笔、总计 8192 点，单笔 4096 点。达到上限时结束当前笔画，撤销不需要的笔迹再继续。
131ca80ce40f134eca467bd880e447efd1a52cee.translation: At most 256 strokes, 8192 total points, and 4096 per stroke. At the limit, end the stroke, undo unwanted strokes, and continue.

4dde6988ce4d2dcd822576788d0d9732e2a1861d.source: 两种绘图模式在当前标签中各自保留笔迹。<s id="0">更换源或重新载入画布会清空对应笔迹</s>。
4dde6988ce4d2dcd822576788d0d9732e2a1861d.translation: Both drawing modes retain their own strokes in the current tab. <s id="0">Changing source or reloading clears corresponding strokes</s>.

eb58c01c922628fda586ec32e5a0f0ead5a70244.source: 关闭未提交笔迹时，选 <s id="0">返回绘图</s> 或 <s id="1">取消关闭</s> 继续，<s id="2">放弃笔迹并关闭会失去未提交内容</s>。刷新或退出前先生成并保存；当前画布和撤销历史没有重开恢复入口。
eb58c01c922628fda586ec32e5a0f0ead5a70244.translation: When closing unsubmitted strokes, <s id="0">Return to drawing</s> or <s id="1">Cancel closing</s> continues; <s id="2">Discard strokes and close loses unsubmitted content</s>. Generate and save before refresh/exit; canvas/undo history cannot be restored after reopening.

6d39626fdcdab282855fc3ef7e5d4b921e18e559.source: 提交后又新增一笔，关闭标签时提示笔迹尚未生成音频；返回绘图保留编辑，放弃笔迹并关闭会失去本次未提交笔迹。
6d39626fdcdab282855fc3ef7e5d4b921e18e559.translation: A stroke added after submission triggers an ungenerated-audio warning on closing. Return to drawing retains edits; discard and close loses unsubmitted strokes.

17eefabc0eb6a09a37d1ddb37f41c143ef5e5296.source: 想继续保留笔迹时选返回绘图，放弃前先核对。
17eefabc0eb6a09a37d1ddb37f41c143ef5e5296.translation: Choose Return to drawing to retain strokes; check before discarding.

a5d2083c9a0e650f19f3353ac3745c933c135b2c.source: 读图、阈值与 FFT 网格
a5d2083c9a0e650f19f3353ac3745c933c135b2c.translation: Reading figures, thresholds, and FFT grids

997bea8cd859f592d98dc86e873dd3bd91d148a7.source: 图片两图灰度不同，比较谱带、条纹和起止即可；音频两图采用相同灰度标度，可定位绘制目标与真实输出的差异。精确测量请使用输出 WAV。
997bea8cd859f592d98dc86e873dd3bd91d148a7.translation: Image-mode plots have different grayscale mappings; compare bands, stripes, and boundaries. Audio plots share a grayscale mapping for locating target/output differences. Use WAV for precise measurement.

a357b354794f0babd2b3fbd7d4fe73adfa28eb1e.source: 图片的白黑 dB 是灰度端点，界面没有另一个二值化阈值。音频固定显示 60 dB；显示为白色的未绘制区域仍保留原幅值。
a357b354794f0babd2b3fbd7d4fe73adfa28eb1e.translation: White/black dB are grayscale endpoints for images; no separate binarization threshold exists. Audio always displays 60 dB; untouched white-looking regions retain original magnitude.

b96cdb53d890740ffcb0cfd4906b5f711c0e1131.source: 图片没有单独的 FFT 输入，网格由校正图尺寸及标定决定。非零频率起点会在更低频处补零，窗长以实际处理条件为准。
b96cdb53d890740ffcb0cfd4906b5f711c0e1131.translation: Image mode has no separate FFT input; grid depends on corrected dimensions/calibration. Nonzero frequency starts add zeros below; use actual processing conditions for window length.

8e678ae991d4d1ea666628ab9fd27a7e2bb4e0ef.source: 音频精度 512、1024、2048 决定分析窗长：较长窗便于区分相近频率，较短窗便于观察短时变化。换精度后重新载入，再绘制。
8e678ae991d4d1ea666628ab9fd27a7e2bb4e0ef.translation: Audio resolution 512, 1024, 2048 sets analysis-window length. Longer windows separate close frequencies; shorter windows show transient changes. Reload after changing, then draw.

1513e1452267d209986b93f76f13aee3891130cd.source: 比较设置时固定源文件，每次只改一个主要参数并保留 JSON。图片实际时长可能略短于填写范围；时间起点用于记录原图坐标，不会在 WAV 前自动补静音。
1513e1452267d209986b93f76f13aee3891130cd.translation: Compare settings with a fixed source, changing one main parameter at a time and retaining JSON. Image output duration may be slightly short; time start records original-image coordinates without prepending silence to WAV.

faf0e3ef8ad822783560648eb427453919c1c130.source: 下表列出初始值。先按素材核对标定，再生成结果；当前设置变化不会更新历史任务。
faf0e3ef8ad822783560648eb427453919c1c130.translation: The table lists initial values. Check calibration against the material before generation; current changes do not update historical tasks.

1d1bc6acef047d7e1f1ba26517d6dee9acdf23c7.source: 图片标定与绘图设置速查
1d1bc6acef047d7e1f1ba26517d6dee9acdf23c7.translation: Image calibration and drawing quick reference

91232b118b20b3be860e5b1531be5f0c61579e39.source: 按下、上边界填写，终点大于起点
91232b118b20b3be860e5b1531be5f0c61579e39.translation: Use lower/upper boundaries; end exceeds start

424da8db5e42e1bdc429fdd63be12dc93636122b.source: 最小 dB（白）/ 最大 dB（黑）

e7639a0037511728ac5d1be4654ef8553ec35452.source: 白端小于黑端，按图源灰度标度填写
e7639a0037511728ac5d1be4654ef8553ec35452.translation: White below black; use source grayscale scale

044523b0c3b02ff80ed9034a7bef24c8fc3337ec.source: 按原分析窗填写，实际值受频谱网格限制
044523b0c3b02ff80ed9034a7bef24c8fc3337ec.translation: Use original analysis window; actual value constrained by spectral grid

d4224bf17b526aa953a73c370f07d88401cd475c.source: 只用于两种图片模式，增加次数会增加计算量
d4224bf17b526aa953a73c370f07d88401cd475c.translation: Image modes only; more iterations cost more computation

06bbe495b2e61bae29f9ea7e41ccb07c0dceed03.source: 自动输出为频率终点×2取整；提高输出采样率不补回原图细节
06bbe495b2e61bae29f9ea7e41ccb07c0dceed03.translation: Auto rounds frequency end ×2; higher output rate does not restore missing image detail

aa4906e55a890237f1d901ab166bd5f4e499e272.source: 固定种子便于图片结果对照

c8819a0d20b75bbe3fad76d01912819105949915.source: 切换后重新载入，页内试听仍默认左声道
c8819a0d20b75bbe3fad76d01912819105949915.translation: Reload after switching; in-page playback still defaults left

ecc009d2ea4d48215cece3b687a28f09d46351c3.source: 仅音频模式；改变后重载清空旧笔迹
ecc009d2ea4d48215cece3b687a28f09d46351c3.translation: Audio only; reloading after changes clears strokes

c96c7b83e66cb7607195dc55a54f47c83726d1dd.source: 白色画笔减弱幅值，恢复前一笔用撤销
c96c7b83e66cb7607195dc55a54f47c83726d1dd.translation: White weakens magnitude; Undo restores a previous stroke

0d50763f5f0269050b013cffc566d5ad6270f642.source: 直径1–200 px，低不透明度适合先试画
0d50763f5f0269050b013cffc566d5ad6270f642.translation: Diameter 1–200 px; try low opacity first

e7ac3ab6109c77095c50ab7aaf26384624ef31c7.source: 仅影响试听，不改变输出WAV

1131ce6d96ca54622c90e0dd80d169b29d533831.source: 每个完成任务的四个结果文件
1131ce6d96ca54622c90e0dd80d169b29d533831.translation: Four result files per completed task

3f6a8f5b41eb3b799c12f39214d9a8afecab14d6.source: 试听选区不会裁剪此文件
3f6a8f5b41eb3b799c12f39214d9a8afecab14d6.translation: Listening selection does not trim this file

bda0349d5b7c1d37ed738394c2f3edbc85cb7371.source: 实际输出重新分析的谱图

594f2326873582bf2395f0aec52e40c813f5f658.source: 源哈希、标定、角点、笔迹、方法与增益
594f2326873582bf2395f0aec52e40c813f5f658.translation: Source hash, calibration, corners, strokes, method, and gain

cf6d621ef84c6c1c0aa4bc0dfe4332b48fba7f77.source: 用于复核条件，目前不能导入为可编辑画布
cf6d621ef84c6c1c0aa4bc0dfe4332b48fba7f77.translation: For checking conditions; currently cannot import as an editable canvas

e0304fee97cef5effbeb9babd4c3ef30dc501335.source: 图片输出为 PCM16 WAV，满幅以外可能削波，请查看削波样本数。音频输出为 FLOAT WAV，注意结果中的增益。<s id="0">两张 PNG 和 JSON 一起保存</s>，可核对绘制目标及当时条件。
e0304fee97cef5effbeb9babd4c3ef30dc501335.translation: Images output PCM16 WAV and may clip beyond full scale; inspect clipped-sample counts. Audio outputs FLOAT WAV; inspect gain. <s id="0">Save both PNGs and JSON together</s> to verify the target and conditions.

d47b924bc4de9b3b1d4b0b96fd4572ffda1ca829.source: 音频未编辑声道不参与算法修改，但 FLOAT 文件写出仍有精度限制。保留原文件，避免把输出视为与源文件字节完全相同。
d47b924bc4de9b3b1d4b0b96fd4572ffda1ca829.translation: Unedited audio channels are not modified algorithmically, but FLOAT writing still has finite precision. Retain originals; do not assume output bytes are identical to source.

959d02631ccc134c1497214b2c112b591447803c.source: 在右栏 <s id="0">重建任务</s> 选择 <s id="1">已完成</s> 条目，核对两图及原始参数快照。
959d02631ccc134c1497214b2c112b591447803c.translation: Select a <s id="1">Completed</s> entry under <s id="0">Reconstruction tasks</s> and check both figures and original snapshot.

744aa2477b50180b68002dbcc2cd2cfd45fdb3eb.source: 点击 <s id="0">保存重建结果</s> 选择目录，等待 <s id="1">已保存 4 个结果文件</s>。取消选目录时任务结果仍在，可稍后再存。
744aa2477b50180b68002dbcc2cd2cfd45fdb3eb.translation: Click <s id="0">Save reconstruction results</s>, choose a directory, and wait for <s id="1">4 result files saved</s>. Cancelled directory selection retains results for later.

27bbcd96cc23e15cb37bbc196963eff88ced407f.source: 核对实际目录和四个文件名。已有不同内容文件会保留，新结果使用新名称；提供下载按钮时逐份下载。
27bbcd96cc23e15cb37bbc196963eff88ced407f.translation: Check actual directory and four names. Existing different content is retained under protected names; download individually where offered.

ac91367225062425a19044fcafe719c98d89bfc1.source: 旧结果不会随当前标定或笔迹改变。需要新设置时重新生成，之后仍可从历史选择旧任务。
ac91367225062425a19044fcafe719c98d89bfc1.translation: Old results do not change with current calibration/strokes. Generate for new settings; old tasks remain selectable from history.

65a5f6ce0e6e7dd25e469f2a65b59340968e50d9.source: 同一音频藏信息任务保存四件套后，右栏显示已保存四个结果文件与已完成任务，中央保留目标和真实输出谱供对照。
65a5f6ce0e6e7dd25e469f2a65b59340968e50d9.translation: After saving the audio-hiding four-file set, the right confirms four files saved and task completed; the center retains target and actual spectra for comparison.

4a1dcdf6770c0302bc7dd28c62d9bfba4622ed77.source: <s id="0">格式或时长不符</s>：使用支持格式，并按输入限制缩短音频。只改扩展名不会转换格式。
4a1dcdf6770c0302bc7dd28c62d9bfba4622ed77.translation: <s id="0">Wrong format or duration</s>: use supported formats and shorten audio to input limits. Renaming an extension does not convert formats.

9baa70570b91e3323bc82163f3afab71c3eec9be.source: <s id="0">四点不完整或交叉</s>：补全有效四点，或 <s id="1">重置为整图</s> 后再试。
9baa70570b91e3323bc82163f3afab71c3eec9be.translation: <s id="0">Incomplete or crossing corners</s>: complete four valid points or <s id="1">Reset to whole image</s> and retry.

8c1341f2f4ca82a3cc4be20fab5c7609c4a9df00.source: <s id="0">标定无效</s>：检查时间、频率终点大于起点，白 dB 小于黑 dB，种子和迭代次数为合法整数。
8c1341f2f4ca82a3cc4be20fab5c7609c4a9df00.translation: <s id="0">Invalid calibration</s>: time/frequency end must exceed start, white dB below black dB, seed/iterations valid integers.

bc5c4ce7c855535a950ce4a9387f089b38663940.source: <s id="0">底图设置已改变</s>：按提示重新载入。旧笔迹会清空，先保留需要的完成结果。
bc5c4ce7c855535a950ce4a9387f089b38663940.translation: <s id="0">Base-image settings changed</s>: reload as prompted, clearing old strokes. Retain needed completed results first.

83c032182618d98e99f4c8ce228445c65aec0d25.source: <s id="0">源已失效或改变</s>：重新选择或导入源，建立新任务。旧任务重试仍沿原条件。
83c032182618d98e99f4c8ce228445c65aec0d25.translation: <s id="0">Source expired or changed</s>: reselect/import source and create a new task. Old-task retries still use original conditions.

682108d98c42ea390b70e1eef19cb402631454fd.source: 图片原图≤2500万像素，重建区域≤100万像素，像素×迭代≤2.56亿，FFT≤16384点。音频还受时频网格限制，30秒和最高采样率的组合可能超限。
682108d98c42ea390b70e1eef19cb402631454fd.translation: Original images ≤25 million pixels, reconstruction regions ≤1 million pixels, pixels × iterations ≤256 million, FFT ≤16384 points. Audio also has time-frequency-grid limits; combining 30 seconds with maximum rate may exceed them.

12d8d8c39ca8fcfaaef5c482aa382b640d5f34f7.source: 要停止排队或计算，点击该任务的 <s id="0">取消任务</s>，等待已取消。切换模块可让已接收任务继续后台运行，关闭标签不会自动取消。
12d8d8c39ca8fcfaaef5c482aa382b640d5f34f7.translation: To stop queued/running work, click its <s id="0">Cancel task</s> and wait for Cancelled. Accepted tasks can run in the background after switching modules; closing tabs does not cancel automatically.

7c7c8640970493f38f2014bf8c79b56020dffcaf.source: 失败、中断或取消后查看该行提示。条件无需变化时用 <s id="0">重试</s>，仍使用原参数和完整笔迹。
7c7c8640970493f38f2014bf8c79b56020dffcaf.translation: Inspect row messages after failure, interruption, or cancellation. <s id="0">Retry</s> reuses original parameters and complete strokes when conditions need no change.

38d24ee971d27bb620bd88a5081b5b9687090c6a.source: 超预算、超时或资源不足时，缩小选区、缩短音频，或降低适当的迭代次数和频谱精度。<s id="0">改设置后重新生成，旧任务重试不会采用新设置。</s>
38d24ee971d27bb620bd88a5081b5b9687090c6a.translation: For exceeded budgets, timeout, or insufficient resources, reduce region/duration or appropriate iteration/resolution settings. <s id="0">Generate anew after edits; old-task retry does not adopt new settings.</s>

e5dc49e624d1161cbe836b41a6706cf9804facbf.source: 连接恢复后从任务历史核对状态。只有已完成任务提供完整结果，画布编辑完成后请生成音频再试听。
e5dc49e624d1161cbe836b41a6706cf9804facbf.translation: After connection recovery, check history status. Only completed tasks offer full results. Generate audio after finishing canvas edits before listening.

0754a874f656cc05af35c4671bc864a5f49f9d57.source: 保存或读取失败时再试

6f060e424644fc2ecb810c170efe9b0aa1144f8b.source: <s id="0">保存失败</s>：保留已完成任务，检查目录权限和剩余空间，改选可写目录再次保存，通常无需重算。
6f060e424644fc2ecb810c170efe9b0aa1144f8b.translation: <s id="0">Save failure</s>: retain the completed task, check permissions/space, and retry in a writable directory. Usually no recomputation is needed.

b352407e93d27430f765068c0aa79db59e4d65b4.source: <s id="0">读取或下载失败</s>：重新选择完成任务或重试单个文件。结果已过期或无法访问时，按原条件重新生成。
b352407e93d27430f765068c0aa79db59e4d65b4.translation: <s id="0">Load/download failure</s>: reselect a completed task or retry an individual file. Regenerate under original conditions if results expired or inaccessible.

3e646ccc11930cda863704d5b5a08b7b0ea75db3.source: <s id="0">任务完成还需成功另存或完整下载四件套。</s> 保存后核对文件数量和实际名称。
3e646ccc11930cda863704d5b5a08b7b0ea75db3.translation: <s id="0">Task completion still requires successful saving or complete download of all four files.</s> Check count and actual names afterward.

3bafa0d38819de1c14874922aaf6327aa8af8fa6.source: 图片路径的相位估计与历史幅值映射
3bafa0d38819de1c14874922aaf6327aa8af8fa6.translation: Image phase estimation and legacy magnitude mapping

79eb960722f5dbc9c523e4af0380e3c304195f16.source: 图片重建采用 Griffin 与 Lim（1984）的相位估计方法，详见本节参考资料和模块 <s id="0">方法与引用</s>。
79eb960722f5dbc9c523e4af0380e3c304195f16.translation: Image reconstruction uses Griffin and Lim's (1984) phase-estimation method. See references here and the module's <s id="0">Methods and references</s>.

8a43410b9f5fbfcfc7fbcca2e84be18b65be3216.source: 图片灰度按填写的标度映射，与音频模式的幅值 dB 分别解释。声压级或绝对幅值测量需另行标定。
8a43410b9f5fbfcfc7fbcca2e84be18b65be3216.translation: Image grayscale maps through the entered scale, distinct from audio magnitude dB. Sound-pressure level or absolute amplitude needs separate calibration.

f43ec87dc970d8dcdde89c5105b7423d7ff0de0a.source: 四点校正只修正选区几何。增加迭代或输出采样率无法补回原图缺失的相位和细节。
f43ec87dc970d8dcdde89c5105b7423d7ff0de0a.translation: Four-point correction changes selection geometry only. More iterations or higher output rates cannot restore missing phase/details.

bd8919f83fb4e75ca9a52d8f3e458beb8624e013.source: 音频路径的原始相位与一致性
bd8919f83fb4e75ca9a52d8f3e458beb8624e013.translation: Original phase and consistency in audio mode

5a14d3587ef687d0f47aaf3e7506f60c28f177ea.source: 音频直接编辑原频谱幅值并保留相位。修改目标未必能完全对应一个声音，因此实际输出谱可能偏离笔迹。
5a14d3587ef687d0f47aaf3e7506f60c28f177ea.translation: Audio directly edits original spectral magnitudes while retaining phase. A modified target may not correspond exactly to a realizable sound, so actual spectra can deviate from strokes.

9b66d975f90d0104bfdceeec4fbec40a0184dbbe.source: NumPy/SciPy、OpenCV 和 SoundFile 提供计算、图像校正和音频读写，来源分别列在 <s id="0">方法与引用</s> 中。
9b66d975f90d0104bfdceeec4fbec40a0184dbbe.translation: NumPy/SciPy, OpenCV, and SoundFile provide computation, image correction, and audio I/O; see their entries in <s id="0">Methods and references</s>.

e5f45406bae6183ea7085348f2a9d3bc50459156.translation: Compare approximate reconstructions under image conditions, or changes before/after drawing in the same audio.
